title: Perfect parking · Level 2: Turn back, then park
brief: Drive until the front bumper reaches the turn-back line at 120 cm (118 cm or beyond counts), then reverse into the bay: its lines at 86 and 94 cm, its middle line at 90 cm. 30 s. 50 for parked after the turn-back line, up to 40 for closeness to the middle line (all 40 within 1 cm, 10 at a bay line), 10 for touching no cone. No par.

score.run: round(if(stopped & (endX + front * cosd(endHeading) - s0) >= lo & (endX + front * cosd(endHeading) - s0) <= hi & visitTime_1 >= 0, 50 + min(40, 50 - abs((endX + front * cosd(endHeading) - s0) - mid) / 10 * 10), 0) + if(touchesOf_coneL + touchesOf_coneR == 0, 10, 0), 1)

finished.value: count(r in runs: r.stopped & (r.endX + front * cosd(r.endHeading) - s0) >= lo & (r.endX + front * cosd(r.endHeading) - s0) <= hi & r.visitTime_1 >= 0)

sources.where: G2.1 Measure the world, Challenge — Perfect parking: the lane, the ruler from the start line (here x 200), the front bumper (the Junior robot's front 90 mm), the bay, the level table (level 2), the scoring paragraph; "How a run is measured". The cones read as 150 mm high, 80 mm across, 200 mm either side of the lane's middle; the bay's lines 10 mm wide, centred on their marks; the turn-back judged by the axle's middle at 118 cm less the front's 90 mm, on a tick the robot faces down the lane within 8 degrees (a one-tick dwell with facing, CC-15: the bumper then at most 90 (1 - cos 8 deg) = 0.9 mm short of 118 cm; a robot turned round never counts, review k1 B1)

§10.2 (endX / endY / endHeading, stopped), §11.8 (end afterProgram), §11.4 (touches by name), §13.1 (the fixed robot), §13.2 (uniform-square-v1), §11.3 with CC-15's facing (a one-tick dwell facing down the lane)
